reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday predicate used by the existing isNonBusinessDay and by the server handler; the handler could have reused isNonBusinessDay (by exporting it) for its weekend-or-holiday test.

duplication.why: The holiday-match rule exists once; the server handler keeps its own isWeekend || isHoliday combination that mirrors isNonBusinessDay.

placement.why: The date-matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the other weekend/holiday helpers.

scope.why: Only the holiday predicate, its two consumers and tests.

maintainability.why: Small, clear helper that every holiday check goes through; the slice(5) month-day extraction is a bit implicit and the import is out of alphabetical order.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both holiday checks go through isHoliday.

disguised_duplication.where: The handler's weekend-or-holiday expression predates the change and now delegates the holiday part to the shared predicate.
